answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a unique physical pigment signature measured from hardware, much as pearl's layered nacre encodes an unforgeable provenance record. Validators then require every new agent to complete a costly voyage of sequential proof-of-work chained to that signature, making mass identity fabrication economically irrational. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
